title: Certificate Matrix for Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44): Forms, Types and Backing
content:
Cardinal Point issues six certificates under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44). Each certificate is fixed by its form (SR-22 or FR-44) and its type (owner, operator or owner-operator). The form and type then fix the kind of state requirement it answers, the states it can be filed with, the product that must back it, and what it certifies.

## Matrix

| Certificate | Form | Type | Requirement answered | Filing states | Backing product |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SR-22 Owner Certificate | SR-22 | owner | non-DUI financial responsibility requirement | FL, VA, TX, GA, AZ, OH | Owner Auto Policy |
| SR-22 Operator Certificate | SR-22 | operator | non-DUI financial responsibility requirement | FL, VA, TX, GA, AZ, OH | Named Non-Owner Policy |
| SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | SR-22 | owner-operator | non-DUI financial responsibility requirement | FL, VA, TX, GA, AZ, OH | Owner Auto Policy |
| FR-44 Owner Certificate | FR-44 | owner | DUI-related license reinstatement, Florida or Virginia | FL, VA | Owner Auto Policy |
| FR-44 Operator Certificate | FR-44 | operator | DUI-related license reinstatement, Florida or Virginia | FL, VA | Named Non-Owner Policy |
| FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate | FR-44 | owner-operator | DUI-related license reinstatement, Florida or Virginia | FL, VA | Owner Auto Policy |

| Certificate | Filer must be the named insured of the backing term | Backing term must schedule at least one vehicle | Certifies the filer in vehicles not scheduled on the backing term |
|---|---|---|---|
| SR-22 Owner Certificate | no | yes | no |
| SR-22 Operator Certificate | yes | no | yes |
| SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | yes | yes | yes |
| FR-44 Owner Certificate | no | yes | no |
| FR-44 Operator Certificate | yes | no | yes |
| FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate | yes | yes | yes |

## Entry terms by certificate

- **SR-22 Owner Certificate**: filed with any served state, on an Owner Auto Policy on which the filer is a rated driver.
- **SR-22 Operator Certificate**: filed with any served state, on the filer's own Named Non-Owner Policy.
- **SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate**: filed with any served state, on an Owner Auto Policy on which the filer is the named insured.
- **FR-44 Owner Certificate**: filed with Florida or Virginia, on an Owner Auto Policy on which the filer is a rated driver, at FR-44 limits.
- **FR-44 Operator Certificate**: filed with Florida or Virginia, on the filer's own Named Non-Owner Policy, at FR-44 limits.
- **FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate**: filed with Florida or Virginia, on an Owner Auto Policy on which the filer is the named insured, at FR-44 limits.

## Terms common to all six certificates

- On an owner backing term the filed driver must be a rated driver and never a named excluded driver. This applies to every certificate in the matrix.
- The filing state may differ from the garaging state or the residence state.
- Where the filing state differs from the garaging state, the limits that apply are those of the filing state's requirement.

## Points of judgement

- *Does an Operator certificate certify a vehicle on a schedule?* No. Both Operator certificates rest on a Named Non-Owner Policy, which need not schedule a vehicle, and they certify the filer while driving vehicles not scheduled on the backing term.
- *Which certificates both require a scheduled vehicle and certify non-owned vehicles?* Only the two Owner-Operator certificates.
- *Hypothetical:* a requirement issued in Ohio for a DUI-related license reinstatement cannot be answered by an FR-44 certificate. FR-44 certificates answer that requirement in Florida or Virginia only, and Ohio is not one of their filing states.
